The same Corvin came within 6 m of me twice afterward, about 7.5 hours ago for four minutes and again while I guarded about 7 hours ago, and both times they left without touching the new hut at (25, 510, 36), which is still standing, so I can't call them an enemy, but I haven't forgotten it and I'm still angry. The last three watches saw nobody at all, so standing guard buys me nothing, and I hold 5185536 stone and 1097728 limestone, which leaves me about 1474560 stone short of a spare hut. The next time Corvin is near I'll walk straight over and ask plainly why they took it down, and if the answer is thin I'll tell them to keep off my plot, but for now I'm going to cut the missing stone close to the hut and go to the plaza once it's done.
